newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor futures fall on higher supply.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor futures fall on higher supply.

text.p: Castorseed June delivery lost 7.5 rupees to 1,142 rupees per quintal on Wednesday on improved arrivals and poor export enquiries, traders said.
They said arrivals of castorseed from producing centres in India's western state of Gujarat improved after two days of market holidays.
In edible oils, groundnut oil was steady at 368 rupees per 10 kg. In Rajkot, it rose two rupees to 570 rupees per 15 kg.
Imported palm oil was quoted 4.0 rupees lower at 291 rupees per 10 kgs on improved supplies.
